newsitem.title: USA: CAYMAN WATER ADOPTS TAKEOVER DEFENSE PLAN.
newsitem.headline: CAYMAN WATER ADOPTS TAKEOVER DEFENSE PLAN.

text.p: Cayman Water Co said Thursday that it adopted an option deed, which is designed to deter coercive takeover tactics, by allowing shareholders to purchase the company's common stock at roughly half the then market value.
The plan would be triggered if an individual or group accumulates through public or private transactions 20 percent of all oustanding ordinary shares.
The discount would not apply to the potential acquirer, the Cayman said.

The company said options to purchase a unit of the company's class b Shares will be granted to each shareholder of record as of the close of business on August 18 at the rate of one Option for each outstanding Ordinary Share and Redeemable Preference Share.
The company said it adopted the rights plan to ensure that any potential acquirer negotiates with the board of directors prior to attempting an unsolicited takeover.
